description: A broad monument has two sweeping outward-flaring legs and a narrow flat top. A tall pointed central opening rises between the legs, with a second shallow curved arch nested inside its upper portion.

A tapering tower spreads into two broad legs beneath a narrow rounded summit and short antenna. Two horizontal platforms cross the body, and a wide curved arch spans the opening between the lower legs.

Two adjoining rectangular building blocks step upward toward the right, where a roof-mounted pole carries a rectangular flag. The taller block has two short horizontal marks along its right side above a shared baseline.
A station facade has a broad arched top above straight side walls and a flat baseline. A circular clock with bent hands sits above a wide semicircular entrance divided by a central upright.

A tall narrow skyscraper has slightly tapering outer sides, a flat upper shoulder, and a pointed spire. An oblique interior seam rises from the base toward the upper-right corner, dividing its two visible faces.
A narrow tower leans to the right above a level ground line. Three sloping floor bands cross its body, with a small arched doorway at the base and a short upright finial above the roof.
A tall tapered obelisk rises from a horizontal ground line to a short pointed summit. A small detached cloud with rounded lobes floats beside its upper-right side as part of the outdoor scene.
A slender obelisk has two gently tapering sides and a pointed cap above a wide horizontal baseline. A small rounded cloud floats to the right of the summit, leaving the tower body unmarked.
A tiered tower narrows upward from a broad base with an arched entrance to a smaller rectangular stage. Two short posts support a triangular roof above the intermediate stage.
